fields.title: 📖 The best of this Dunyā
fields.body:
🖋️ **Mālik ibn Dīnār** رحمه الله said:

***“The people of the Dunyā left the Dunyā without having tasted the most delightful thing in it.”***

He was asked:

***“And what is that?”***

He replied:

***“The knowledge of the Exalted Allāh.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The most precious thing of this world does not lie in possession, status, or pleasure. Whoever knows the Exalted Allāh through His revelation, loves Him, and obeys Him has tasted the most delightful thing of the Dunyā. Whoever misses this may possess much and still lose the best.

immutable.source: 📝 aḏ-Ḏahabī, Siyar Aʿlām an-Nubalāʾ, Biografie von Mālik ibn Dīnār, Bd. 5, S. 363
